story: Imagine a sketch artist who starts with static and, stroke by stroke, sharpens it into a face. Here is the short version: Slopaganda is a portmanteau of "slop" and "propaganda", referring to AI-generated content designed to manipulate beliefs, emotions, and political decision-making at scale. The part that makes it sing: The term is credited to Michał Klincewicz, an assistant professor in the Department of Computational Cognitive Science at Tilburg University, in 2025. The model dreams a little, then cleans up the dream. And that is Slopaganda — making something new out of everything it has ever seen.
